proposed_bounded_trial_NOT_APPROVED.runtime: Pinned AXK2 reference operators plus necessary A100/FP8 loader adaptations; native PyTorch pipelining scheduler. Not an officially supported unmodified SKT vLLM configuration.

proposed_bounded_trial_NOT_APPROVED.memory_caveat: 16 nodes is a provisional ceiling, not a measured proof that the target concurrency/context fits.
proposed_bounded_trial_NOT_APPROVED.before_scale_out: Implement cache/request routing, validate shape/state correctness locally, then bounded stage-memory GPU preflight before allocating the remaining nodes.
proposed_bounded_trial_NOT_APPROVED.no_silent_scope_reduction: A partial-block or CPU pass must not be reported as successful full-model GPU validation.
proposed_bounded_trial_NOT_APPROVED.exit_policy: Stop on deadline, capacity failure, memory failure, eviction or failed correctness; collect evidence and delete all dedicated resources.
